newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Sturdy Bunds eye 102.50 for sharp gains.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Sturdy Bunds eye 102.50 for sharp gains.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE are trending upwards and a break of 102.50 will pave the way for stronger gains, chart analysts said on Monday.
Nico Bakker, technical analyst at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam, said despite the market's current hesitation and initial resistance at 102.00, further gains were likely.

"We will be focusing on the 102.50 area today. If that's broken, it will suggest failure of a diamond reversal pattern on weekly continuation charts," he said, adding that gains could then be extended to 104.00.
By 0700 GMT, September Bund futures were 0.07 up at 101.90.
Bakker said Bunds were in very a narrow range and could only muster some momentum if 102.00 was broken. That level is near the highs in May and is also channel line resistance.
Bakker saw first support coming in at 101.90, which was previously resistance, followed by short-term trendline support at 101.55.

David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said the market was running into a wall and unless 102.05 resistance was overcome, pressure was building up for a correction. "Just on risk-reward you got to look to sell up here," Sneddon said.
He said 102.05 was the resistance line connecting the May and June highs.
"The market's got to get above 102.05 to give some impetus to the upside move...but pressure for correction lower has increased quite significantly," Sneddon said.
He pegged initial price support at the 101.78/77 area. But key support was the band between 101.58,101.50 which marked a pivot level and accelerated uptrend.
"If it can't hold above 101.58,101.50, then it will get a quick swing back to 101.37,101.35 and 101.10,100.94 (June 20 low)." September Euromark futures were 0.01 down at 96.85.
